name: postbox-game-web-styles
description: Tailwind build for the static pages in web/ (/get, /invite, /support, /privacy-policy, /data-safety). Not part of the Flutter app.

scripts.check: tailwindcss --input src/site.css --output .site.check.css --minify && cmp -s .site.check.css ../web/site.css; status=$?; rm -f .site.check.css; if [ $status -ne 0 ]; then echo 'web/site.css is stale: run npm run build in web_styles/ and commit it.' >&2; fi; exit $status
